title: Graph Topology as Attention
subtitle: Structured Knowledge Injection Beyond Text
abstract: We investigate whether knowledge graph topology, encoded as structured text, enables language models to recover relational information. A powered study (552 queries, 4 conditions, 3 runs) shows that walk-encoded graph topology enables 47.2% multi-hop recovery vs 0.5% baseline, though flat natural-language text scores higher (67.6%). A companion decomposition study shows direct KV cache injection achieves perfect topology recovery (1.000), with K and V tensors contributing superadditively. Text-mediated graph encoding is a viable injection channel; direct KV injection is the more powerful path.
